metadata.question: Did the snow water equivelent at Donner Pass higher in February than April in 2022?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: NASA SMAP "NASA/SMAP/SPL4SMGP/007" has snow water equivalent (SWE) data - Date: February 2022 vs April 2022 - Location: Donner Pass, California (approximate coordinates: -120.32°W, 39.32°N) 2. Masking strategy: - SWE data doesn't need cloud masking - Will compare mean SWE values for February vs April 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Valid Zero: SWE can legitimately be 0 (no snow), this is a valid measurement → answer A or B - C1: If no images found for either month - C2: If pixel count is 0 after processing - C3: If result is None/NaN or invalid (negative SWE values would be invalid) ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time Definitions donner_pass = ee.Geometry.Point([-120.32, 39.32]) feb_start = '2022-02-01' feb_end = '2022-03-01' apr_start = '2022-04-01' apr_end = '2022-05-01' # 2. Data Acquisition & Check smap = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/SMAP/SPL4SMGP/007') feb_col = smap.filterDate(feb_start, feb_end).filterBounds(donner_pass) apr_col = smap.filterDate(apr_start, apr_end).filterBounds(donner_pass) feb_size = feb_col.size().getInfo() apr_size = apr_col.size().getInfo() print(f"February 2022 images: {feb_size}") print(f"April 2022 images: {apr_size}") if feb_size == 0 or apr_size == 0: print("Missing data for one or both months") print("C1") else: # 3. Processing - Get mean SWE for each month feb_mean = feb_col.select('swe_mean').mean() apr_mean = apr_col.select('swe_mean').mean() # Check pixel counts feb_count = feb_mean.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=donner_pass, scale=3000, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('swe_mean').getInfo() apr_count = apr_mean.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=donner_pass, scale=3000, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('swe_mean').getInfo() print(f"February valid pixels: {feb_count}") print(f"April valid pixels: {apr_count}") if feb_count == 0 or apr_count == 0: print("No valid pixels after processing") print("C2") else: # 4. Calculation feb_swe = feb_mean.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=donner_pass, scale=3000, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('swe_mean').getInfo() apr_swe = apr_mean.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=donner_pass, scale=3000, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('swe_mean').getInfo() print(f"February 2022 mean SWE: {feb_swe:.2f} mm") print(f"April 2022 mean SWE: {apr_swe:.2f} mm") # 5. Validation & Final Answer if feb_swe is None or apr_swe is None: print("Calculation returned None") print("C3") elif feb_swe < 0 or apr_swe < 0: print("Invalid negative SWE values") print("C3") elif feb_swe > apr_swe: print("February SWE was higher than April") print("A") else: print("February SWE was NOT higher than April") print("B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
donner_pass = ee.Geometry.Point([-120.32, 39.32])
feb_start = '2022-02-01'
feb_end = '2022-03-01'
apr_start = '2022-04-01'
apr_end = '2022-05-01'

# 2. Data Acquisition & Check
smap = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/SMAP/SPL4SMGP/007')

feb_col = smap.filterDate(feb_start, feb_end).filterBounds(donner_pass)
apr_col = smap.filterDate(apr_start, apr_end).filterBounds(donner_pass)

feb_size = feb_col.size().getInfo()
apr_size = apr_col.size().getInfo()

print(f"February 2022 images: {feb_size}")
print(f"April 2022 images: {apr_size}")

if feb_size == 0 or apr_size == 0:
    print("Missing data for one or both months")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
else:
    # 3. Processing - Get mean SWE for each month
    feb_mean = feb_col.select('swe_mean').mean()
    apr_mean = apr_col.select('swe_mean').mean()
    
    # Check pixel counts
    feb_count = feb_mean.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry=donner_pass,
        scale=3000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('swe_mean').getInfo()
    
    apr_count = apr_mean.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry=donner_pass,
        scale=3000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('swe_mean').getInfo()
    
    print(f"February valid pixels: {feb_count}")
    print(f"April valid pixels: {apr_count}")
    
    if feb_count == 0 or apr_count == 0:
        print("No valid pixels after processing")
        print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    else:
        # 4. Calculation
        feb_swe = feb_mean.reduceRegion(
            reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
            geometry=donner_pass,
            scale=3000,
            maxPixels=1e9
        ).get('swe_mean').getInfo()
        
        apr_swe = apr_mean.reduceRegion(
            reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
            geometry=donner_pass,
            scale=3000,
            maxPixels=1e9
        ).get('swe_mean').getInfo()
        
        print(f"February 2022 mean SWE: {feb_swe:.2f} mm")
        print(f"April 2022 mean SWE: {apr_swe:.2f} mm")
        
        # 5. Validation & Final Answer
        if feb_swe is None or apr_swe is None:
            print("Calculation returned None")
            print("<answer>C3</answer>")
        elif feb_swe < 0 or apr_swe < 0:
            print("Invalid negative SWE values")
            print("<answer>C3</answer>")
        elif feb_swe > apr_swe:
            print("February SWE was higher than April")
            print("<answer>A</answer>")
        else:
            print("February SWE was NOT higher than April")
            print("<answer>B</answer>")
